Hyperreal cinematic photograph for a Shopify EOFY sale hero banner, 16:9 widescreen landscape composition.

[Context] DiggerLid EOFY 2026 sale hero — uses the brand's natural digging metaphor: an excavator literally digs up the lawn to reveal the sale text carved into the dirt beneath.

[Visual] Wide cinematic golden-hour shot of a sunlit rural Australian field with thick lush green grass in the foreground. A yellow XCMG XE17U compact mini-excavator fitted with a custom grey DiggerLid PRO Enclosure cover sits on the right side of the frame, three-quarter angle, bucket extended downward and forward. The bucket has just peeled back a large rectangular section of turf — the grass is rolled back like a carpet, exposing rich dark-brown topsoil beneath. Carved into and rising up from the exposed dirt are massive bold 3D block-letter sculpted-earth letters spelling 'EOFY SALE' — the letters look pressed and packed from compacted soil, with cracked edges, loose dirt clods scattered around the base, and crumbs of earth stuck to the letterforms. The text dominates the lower-left two-thirds of the frame. Warm low-angle sunlight rakes across the scene from the right, casting long shadows from each letter. Dust haze in the air around the bucket. Eucalyptus trees blurred in the distant background. Sky is warm orange-gold sunset clouds.

[Format] 16:9 widescreen landscape, hero banner aspect.

[Style] Hyperreal cinematic product-advertising photography, dramatic editorial composition, premium register matching Mous-tier advertising. Hyperreal detail on the grass, the dirt clods, the letter texture, the machine paintwork and the grey PRO Enclosure cover. Warm cinematic colour grade — saturated greens, rich browns, golden-amber highlights. Anamorphic lens feel. ONLY the text 'EOFY SALE' appears anywhere in the artwork — no other words, no logos, no watermarks.

A grey tombstone behind him reads 'TAX MAN' in carved letters. Above the scene a yellow comic-style sunburst radiates outward, dollar-bill and gold-coin confetti rains down across the frame. Across the lower-centre of the frame, the headline text 'EOFY SALE' rendered in massive bold cartoon-display typography — chunky red-and-white letters with thick black outline, slight 3D extrusion. Above Luke's head a comic speech bubble reads 'BURY THE TAXMAN!' in bold black sans-serif.
